title: Customizations
description: V11 — Session sidebar (pared back). From the Nov 5 Customization Squad Sync: no customization UI in the composer. The right sidebar holds only what you can turn on and off for a session: plugins, MCP servers and connectors, with Ask first as an advanced ⋯ option. Everything lower level (skills, instructions, agents, hooks, tools, canvases) and Discover open the Customizations modal, narrowed to the session. The modal is V10's.
